summary: StartEngine Inc. filed an Item 8.01 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing that it has determined to terminate its Regulation A offering (SEC File No. 024-12778). The company confirms it did not issue or sell any securities under that offering, so no capital was raised and no dilution occurred. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction counterparty is stated. This is a routine withdrawal of a shelved Reg A registration rather than a special situation; the practical read is that the issuer retains its authorized but unissued shares and could refile later, while no arbitrage or deal terms attach.
